visual_action: Jennifer Lopez walks onto a stage at what appears to be a large indoor political rally. She wears a form-fitting brown dress. A crowd behind her holds up blue and red signs, some of which read "WHEN WE VOTE WE WIN". She waves and smiles as she approaches a podium that has the seal of the Vice President of the United States on it. The video ends with close-up shots of her speaking to the cheering crowd from the podium.
